name: Saquon Barkley

background.fact: Saquon Rasul Quevis Barkley was born February 9, 1997 in the Bronx, New York, and the family moved to the Lehigh Valley in Pennsylvania in 2001; they settled in Coplay in 2005.

At Whitehall High School he rushed for 3,646 yards and 63 touchdowns from sophomore to senior year, was co-winner of Mr. Pennsylvania Football in 2014, and also lettered in basketball and track (100 meters in 10.90 seconds).
At Penn State he set school records for career all-purpose yards (5,538) and rushing touchdowns (43), finished fourth in the 2017 Heisman voting, and left after three seasons.
The Giants drafted him second overall in 2018; he was Offensive Rookie of the Year, went to the Pro Bowl in 2018 and 2022, and signed a three-year deal with the Eagles after the 2023 season.
In 2024 he ran for over 2,000 yards (2,005 in the data file) with Philadelphia, helped win Super Bowl LIX, and was named AP Offensive Player of the Year.

background.fact: Listed at 6 ft 0 in, 233 lb, age 29, jersey 26, in his ninth NFL season; career regular season totals are 8,652 rushing yards, 58 rushing touchdowns, 365 catches in 113 games.

family.fact: His father Alibay Barkley is a former boxer, his mother is Tonya Johnson, he has three brothers and two sisters, his brother Alibay Jr. was drafted by the Los Angeles Angels, and his great uncle is former WBC middleweight champion Iran Barkley.
On February 2, 2025 he announced his engagement to Anna Congdon, his college sweetheart. Wikipedia says the couple have two children; nothing further about the children is recorded here.
He is an investor in Ramp (he starred in its 2025 Super Bowl commercial) and other startups, and was the Madden 26 cover athlete.
